attributes.name: repeating_traits_-MO1dE7YvA8flMb8ywWK_description
attributes.current: Your tenacity can wear down the most potent foes. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, the creature takes an extra 1d8 damage if it's below its hit point maximum. You can deal this extra damage only once per turn.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-1_-MO1gi30OOyKPwaCnHOS_spellathigherlevels
attributes.current: If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-1_-MO1gi30OOyKPwaCnHOS_spelldescription
attributes.current:
The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, a writhing mass of thorny vines appears at the point of impact, and the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be restrained by the magical vines until the spell ends. A Large or larger creature has advantage on this saving throw. If the target succeeds on the save, the vines shrivel away.

While restrained by this spell, the target takes 1d6 piercing damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature restrained by the vines or one that can touch the creature can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC. On a success, the target is freed.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-1_-MO1gjHi1FtF2GGN4Wr0_spelldescription
attributes.current:
Up to ten berries appear in your hand and are infused with magic for the duration. A creature can use its action to eat one berry. Eating a berry restores 1 hit point, and the berry provides enough nourishment to sustain a creature for one day.

The berries lose their potency if they have not been consumed within 24 hours of the casting of this spell.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-1_-MO1gomZgvnTtm9I3NBG_spelldescription
attributes.current: You gain the ability to comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts for the duration. The knowledge and awareness of many beasts is limited by their intelligence, but at minimum, beasts can give you information about nearby locations and monsters, including whatever they can perceive or have perceived within the past day. You might be able to persuade a beast to perform a small favor for you, at the DM's discretion.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-1_-MO1gsrB5h9APf8eq2Ou_spellathigherlevels
attributes.current: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd or 4th level, you can maintain your concentration on the spell for up to 8 hours. When you use a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you can maintain your concentration on the spell for up to 24 hours.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-1_-MO1gsrB5h9APf8eq2Ou_spelldescription
attributes.current: You choose a creature you can see within range and mystically mark it as your quarry. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 1d6 damage to the target whenever you hit it with a weapon attack, and you have advantage on any Wisdom (Perception) or Wisdom (Survival) check you make to find it. If the target drops to 0 hit points before this spell ends, you can use a bonus action on a subsequent turn of yours to mark a new creature.

attributes.name: bonds
attributes.current: Having lived among the people of a primeval tribe or clan, I long to return and see how they are faring.

attributes.name: character_appearance
attributes.current: a tall human with a lean build and tan skin. has black hair and yellow eyes. wears a simple green shirt and black pants worn over high-quality leather armor. has signs of an injury on his index finger, a result of continued archery training. wears a thumb ring. carries a rapier on the belt and a longbow on his back.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-1_-MO64cjghLLVhGJTgkZR_spelldescription
attributes.current:
You make yourself—including your clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings on your person—look different until the spell ends or until you use your action to dismiss it. You can seem 1 foot shorter or taller and can appear thin, fat, or in between. You can't change your body type, so you must adopt a form that has the same basic arrangement of limbs. Otherwise, the extent of the illusion is up to you.

The changes wrought by this spell fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, if you use this spell to add a hat to your outfit, objects pass through the hat, and anyone who touches it would feel nothing or would feel your head and hair. If you use this spell to appear thinner than you are, the hand of someone who reaches out to touch you would bump into you while it was seemingly still in midair.

To discern that you are disguised, a creature can use its action to inspect your appearance and must succeed on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC.

attributes.name: character_backstory
attributes.current:
i was born into a small community of humans, who out of desperations were driven to pillage and kill. my parents (human father, elf mother), who were kind hearted couldn't bear to live in such a community. when they managed to gather enough rations to survive for a couple weeks, they left the community at night, when i was 5 years old. 
They managed to find a halfling village, who agreed to help people in such need. eventually, my father started working as a blacksmith and my mother joined the local inn as a bartender. I was enrolled into the local school, I was taught the culture of halflings, from their behavior to language. when i was 14, the school enrolled another teacher, an elf who also sought to seek refuge in the halfling village. he started teaching elvish, archery and worked on preserving the sylvan language. I learnt both of those languages under him, and also started to learn archery.
i was instantly hooked onto the art of the bow and arrow. i would spend hours a day just drawing the bow over and over in secret, despite my teacher warning me of burnout and causing trigger finger. I eventually did get injured and was diagnosed with trigger finger. I was devastated that i could not practice archery anymore. seeing my sorry state, my father decided to craft a thumb ring, which he gifted to me as a way to congratulate me learning archery, i was accustomed to using the thumb ring, and i became just as good at aiming with the thumb ring as i was without it. seeing my growth, Hagas handed me his bow, which was made of high-quality yew wood, and crafted by a woodworker Hagas claimed to was one of the best in the world.

attributes.name: repeating_traits_-MR0RDrHMECbjJFlEmpB_description
attributes.current:
During your rogue training you learned thieves' cant, a secret mix of dialect, jargon, and code that allows you to hide messages in seemingly normal conversation. Only another creature that knows thieves' cant understands such messages. It takes four times longer to convey such a message than it does to speak the same idea plainly.

In addition, you understand a set of secret signs and symbols used to convey short, simple messages, such as whether an area is dangerous or the territory of a thieves' guild, whether loot is nearby, or whether the people in an area are easy marks or will provide a safe house for thieves on the run.

attributes.name: repeating_traits_-MT6mZtWXw9ZOSPnHK6y_description
attributes.current: Starting at 2nd level, your quick thinking and agility allow you to move and act quickly. You can take a bonus action on each of your turns in combat. This action can be used only to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

attributes.name: repeating_traits_-MT6mZtn1RFqjFAXAAdB_description
attributes.current:
2nd-level rogue feature (enhances Cunning Action)

You gain an additional way to use your Cunning Action: carefully aiming your next attack. As a bonus action, you give yourself advantage on your next attack roll on the current turn. You can use this bonus action only if you haven't moved during this turn, and after you use the bonus action, your speed is 0 until the end of the current turn.
